segments.en: One whose merchandise and estates are scattered, and not in one place -- sometimes he is saved through this from having to tear his garments for his deceased.

segments.he:
ב.

סְגֻלָּה לְמַפֶּלֶת נְפָלִים שֶׁתִּשָּׂא אֶצְלָהּ מַגְנֵט, גַּם תִּשָּׂא אֶצְלָהּ חֲתִיכַת עֵץ מִקֶּבֶר הַצַּדִּיק, גַּם יִתֵּן צְדָקָה.
segments.en: The largest businessman in a city is the light  (lit. candle)  of the city.

segments.he:
ג.

אִשָּׁה שֶׁהִיא מַפֶּלֶת, תִּשָּׂא אֶצְלָהּ מֵי טַל.
segments.en: Due to fear, a woman miscarries.

A  segulah (conducive)  for  a woman that  miscarriages with stillborns, is that she should carry with her a magnet. Also, she should carry with her a piece of wood from the grave of a  T zaddik . Also, she should give charity.

segments.he:
ה.

בַּעֲווֹן שִׂנְאַת־חִנָּם הָאִשָּׁה מַפֶּלֶת נְפָלִים.
segments.en: A woman who is prone to miscarry should carry with her dew-water.

segments.he:
ו.

עַל־יְדֵי תַּאֲוַת אֲכִילָה וּשְׁתִיָּה שֶׁלָּהּ הִיא מַפֶּלֶת.
segments.en: A  segulah (conducive)  for one who miscarries, is  that she should sell her fetus.
On account of the sin of needless hatred, a woman miscarries stillborns.

segments.he:
ח.

אִשָּׁה הַמַּפֶּלֶת נְפָלִים, לֹא תֵּלֵךְ בְּקִשּׁוּטֵי זָהָב.
segments.en: Through her lust for food and drink, she miscarries.

segments.he:
ט.

הַטְּחִינָה שֶׁל קֶמַח וְהַלִּישָׁה  שֶׁל הַמַּצּוֹת שֶׁל פֶּסַח הִ י א סְגֻלָּה לְאִשָּׁה, שֶׁמַּפֶּלֶת נְפָלִים.

segments.en: A woman who miscarries stillborns should not go with golden jewelry.
The grinding of flour and kneading of the matzah of Passover is a  segulah (conducive)  that miscarries with stillborns.
